description: Two fixed oracle addresses with deterministic seeds, sorted by address XDR before SHA-256 aggregation
note: Addresses are fixed Stellar strkey addresses. Seeds 0xCAFEBABE and 0xDEADBEEF sorted by address XDR (lexicographic), concatenated as 8-byte big-endian, then SHA-256 hashed. First 8 bytes of hash interpreted as big-endian u64.
